meta.description: Your nick-lukashik account: sign-in, sessions, coin wallet, payments and notifications.

login.title: Sign in
login.heading: Sign in
login.lead: Enter your email: we will send a six-digit code. A new account is created on the first sign-in.
login.codeSent: We sent a code to {email}. It is valid for 10 minutes.

errors.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Wait a minute and try again.
errors.unavailable: Sign-in is unavailable right now. Try again a little later.
errors.invalid_code: The code is not right. Check the email and try again.
errors.expired: The code has expired. Ask for a new one.
errors.too_many_attempts: Too many wrong codes. Ask for a new one.
errors.google_failed: Google sign-in did not work. Try again.
errors.google_unavailable: Google sign-in is unavailable right now. Use an email code.
errors.google_link_required: This email already has an account. Sign in with an email code, then link Google on the account page.
errors.google_unverified: Google has not confirmed this email. Use an email code.

login.reauthLead: Confirm it is you: sign in again. This replaces the current session on this device.

account.title: Account
account.heading: Account
account.error: The change was not saved. Try again.
account.unavailable: The account is unavailable right now. Try again a little later.
account.passkeysLead: Sign in with a fingerprint, your face or the device PIN, with no code.
account.unlinkedGoogle: Google is unlinked. The email code still works.

googleErrors.google_failed: Google did not work. Try again.
googleErrors.google_unavailable: Google is unavailable right now. Try again later.
googleErrors.google_in_use: This Google account is linked to another account.
googleErrors.google_already_linked: Another Google account is linked already. Unlink it first.
googleErrors.google_link_required: Google did not work. Try again.
googleErrors.google_unverified: Google has not confirmed the email of this account.

wallet.heading: Wallet
wallet.restricted: The wallet is restricted: spending is paused. Contact support.
wallet.paid: Payment received. The coins appear in a few seconds.
wallet.checkoutError: The payment could not be started. Try again.

payments.heading: Payments

error.title: Something went wrong
error.body: The page could not be shown. Try again; if it keeps failing, come back a little later.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.body: There is no page at this address. It may have moved or never existed.

errors.cancelled: No passkey was used: cancelled, timed out, or there is none for this site on this device.
errors.not_allowed: Passkeys are not allowed on this page.
errors.stale: The request has expired. Try again.
errors.rejected: The passkey was not accepted. Try again or use an email code.
errors.unknown: This passkey is no longer linked to an account. Use an email code.
errors.exists: This device already has a passkey for your account.
errors.limit: You have the most passkeys allowed. Remove one first.
errors.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Wait a minute and try again.
errors.unavailable: Passkeys are unavailable right now. Try again a little later.
errors.reauth_required: To add a passkey, confirm it is you first.

authorize.title: The sign-in link does not work
authorize.body: This sign-in link is broken or out of date. Go back to the site and press “Sign in” again.
